policy: Every sequence shipped in this example workspace is redistribution-clean: Tier-A (OpenMTA / NCBI public-domain / CC0 / CC-BY) or Tier-B (a published, non-copyrightable DNA sequence used as fact, attributed). No sequence is downloaded from Addgene’s website (their ToS forbids redistributing content obtained there). Tier-B sequences are obtained from primary literature or third-party redistributions under their own license (e.g. the MIT-licensed althonos/moclo registry); the DNA sequence itself is not copyrightable, and we are not a party to Addgene’s ToS via those sources.
